overviews.title: What is Exhibition Design? Courses, Fees, Top Institutes, Careers & Salary 2026

blocks.value: The Exhibition Design is a design course. It teaches you the art of narrative communication or storytelling to attract, inform, and entertain a real-time audience . Exhibition Design equips one with knowledge and skills of spatial planning, image manipulation, colour, lighting, and multimedia to create engaging physical and virtual environments.

Admissions are taken through entrance exams like NID Entrance, NID DAT, etc. The eligibility criteria for these courses are to pass Class 12 with any stream from a recognized board. You can pursue Exhibition design via degrees like BDes and MDes. Some popular Exhibition Design colleges in India include NIFT Delhi, Apeejay Institute, AAA, YWCA, JD Institute of Fashion Technology, etc. The average Exhibition Design course fees can range from INR 5 Lakh to INR 15 Lakh.

Employment sectors for this field include Hospitality, Textile Design, Interior Design , etc. The average salary of an Exhibition Designer is INR 5 LPA. Exhibition Design graduates can leverage their skills to contribute to areas like brand launches, themed fairs and festivals or cultural installations. Exhibition Design is the new face of experiential marketing and branding.

faqs.question: What is Exhibition Design?
faqs.answer: Exhibition Design is a narrative communication. It is narrative, spatial layout, colour, lighting and multimedia. It prepares students to create displays to present data, artefacts, goods or experiences in an immersive and visually appealing way. is the multidisciplinary field of exhibition design. It includes a variety of settings, including galleries, trade exhibitions, museums, stores, and events.

faqs.question: What is the scope of Exhibition Design?
faqs.answer: Exhibition Design degree gives various choices for students to pursue after completion such as opting for a job or pursuing higher studies in other related designing courses. Candidates can opt for jobs like Interior Designers, Textile Designers, Product Designers, etc. Upon pursuing exhibition design, a candidate has a multitude of job options at their disposal. There is good opportunity for students in this field. Being an exhibition designer is one of the most sought-after career paths available to applicants. Outdoor events, museum exhibits, trade shows, showroom displays, conferences, and other events are frequently under their purview. In addition to being an Exhibition Designer, a prospective applicant can pursue careers as a Product Designer, Textile Designer, Industrial Designer, and numerous other fields.

faqs.question: How do I become an Exhibition Designer?
faqs.answer: Education, experience and a solid portfolio are necessary to become an exhibition designer. Get a degree in exhibition design, interior design, architecture, etc to begin. Gain expertise with design tools and exhibition space creation skills. Getting hands-on experience is necessary by applying for internships or entry-level jobs in event management, design or museums.

faqs.question: Why should I opt for an Exhibition Design course?

blocks.value: Exhibition Design is a design specialisation. It aims to have students master venue design skills to turn their passion into a professional career.
It teaches several design disciplines that are necessary for success in the field of design.
They examine the process of designing exhibitions in the context of Museums, Cultural Collecting Institutions, and Heritage Agencies.
They also investigate contemporary innovative exhibitions, as well as their designs, technologies, audience development, project management, and stakeholder consultation.
